title: dianthus collinus var. scaber
intro: Dianthus collinus var. scaber, commonly known as Fringed Pink, is a flowering plant species in the carnation family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Dianthus collinus var. scaber include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities.
